review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 39 physical PDF pages; pages 7, 12 and 38 were additionally rendered to verify equations (4), (12) and reference [30]. Citation punctuation spacing after inline math is repaired by the shared OCR normalizer rather than a document patch. Figure label fragments on physical pages 31-32 and flattened table boundaries were left unchanged without clearer source evidence.

patches.evidence: Rendered PDF physical p.7 equation (4) shows calligraphic E with a lowercase ell subscript, and the following sentence uses the same E_l for the task-level understanding representation; OCR read the subscript as the digit 1.
Rendered PDF physical p.12 equation (12) reads s ~ Uniform{1, ..., 1000}; OCR spaced the digits of 1000 and inserted a space before the set brace.
Rendered PDF physical p.38 reference [30] reads "arXiv preprint arXiv:2503.20314, 2025."; the backslash-underscore is a Markdown escape added by OCR, not source text.

unresolved.evidence: Scattered axis labels and ticks from Figures 20-21 are interleaved with the preceding paragraph in OCR order; the source confirms they belong to the figures.
Some OCR HTML tables appear to concatenate column text or lose cell structure; a page-by-page comparison is needed before changing recorded values.
